levels.name: Milo, 21, Night-Shift Janitor
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 1. Level 1: 0.3 views on my midnight cooking stream while my dry toast smells like burnt paper. My name is Milo, I am a 21-year-old bananaed janitor scrubbing dirty hospital floors in Queens for $14 an hour. It is 3:14 AM and I am watching a 4K video of a golden-brown roast chicken while chewing cold butter on plain bread. Suddenly, a strange sound echoes from the hallway, and the hospital lights flicker violently into total darkness. You call this burnt garbage a midnight snack, you pathetic yellow peel? I clutch my single piece of white toast and try to hide my screen, but my heart is pounding so hard it hurts because footsteps are approaching my supply closet. Just as I think I am completely safe, a heavy knock rattles the metal door and a cold voice whispers through the crack. You will never taste real butter, boy. But little does this arrogant critic know, a hidden camera is recording every single tear. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Penny, 24, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 2. Level 2: 14 views on my recipe remix and my landlord is threatening to lock the kitchen. My name is Penny, I am a 24-year-old strawberry barista pouring oat milk lattes in Brooklyn for $16 an hour. It is 2:50 AM and my phone battery is at 4 percent while I watch a 10-hour loop of sizzling bacon. Right in the middle of my livestream, the espresso machine downstairs explodes with a deafening hiss, spraying hot steam across the entire cafe floor. Stop making noise with your stupid butter knife, nobody cares about your kitchen failures! I wipe the dark brown liquid off my apron, feeling hot tears sting my bruised strawberry skin. Suddenly, my phone screen flashes with an unexpected notification that changes everything in an instant. Your recipes taste like cardboard and despair. But the viewer count is starting to climb despite the chaos. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Sam, 29, Delivery Driver
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 3. Level 3: 1.2K views on my toast tutorial and my rent check just bounced for the second time. My name is Sam, I am a 29-year-old orange delivery driver riding a broken electric bike through Chicago traffic for $19 an hour. It is 3:30 AM and my stomach is completely empty while I stream a famous chef cutting a five-tier chocolate cake. Without any warning, a speeding yellow cab splashes icy puddle water all over my delivery jacket and ruins my phone screen. You think a thousand views makes you a chef, delivery boy? I grip my handlebar tightly, trying to swallow the lump of shame rising in my throat as my brakes fail completely on the downhill slope. Just as I am about to crash into a fruit stand, a mysterious package falls from my basket. You are just delivering trash while eating garbage. And the worst part is someone is filming my failure from the shadows. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Leo, 32, Sous Chef
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 4. Level 4: 9.8 million views on my midnight carbonara tutorial and my boss just demoted me. My name is Leo, I am a 32-year-old broccoli sous chef chopping onions in a Michelin-star Los Angeles kitchen for $22 an hour. It is 4:00 AM and I am eating buttered toast over a stainless steel sink while checking my analytics. Suddenly, the main refrigerator trips its circuit breaker, spoiling thousands of dollars worth of gourmet ingredients in seconds. Nine million views and you still eat like a homeless rat. I clench my chef knife so hard my wooden knuckles turn white as the restaurant alarm system begins to wail. You are a kitchen peasant playing dress-up. But then a secret document slips out of the broken freezer door, revealing a conspiracy that goes straight to the top. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Maya, 26, Food Stylist
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 5. Level 5: 22.4K views on my midnight pancake art and my studio lights just blew up. My name is Maya, I am a 26-year-old lemon food stylist arranging fake berries in a studio loft for $24 an hour. It is 3:15 AM and I am eating plain toast with butter while editing frame rates. Out of nowhere, the ceiling sprinkler system malfunctions, soaking all my professional photography gear in dirty water. Stop pretending you are a professional, your styling is an absolute joke! I drop my editing stylus, feeling the bitter acid rise in my throat like a fresh lemon as my hard drive begins to smoke. You will never make it to the front page. But as the sparks fly, a strange digital file appears on my desktop from an unknown sender. You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Koko, 35, Cafe Owner
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 6. Level 6: 45K views on my secret coffee blend recipe and my basement is flooded with water. My name is Koko, I am a 35-year-old coconut cafe owner wiping espresso counters in Miami for $28 an hour. It is 3:45 AM and I am eating toasted brioche while counting my daily tips. Suddenly, a pipe bursts beneath the floorboards, sending dirty brown water gushing over my expensive ceramic tile. Forty-five thousand views and you still hide behind a coffee counter, coconut? I grab a heavy ceramic mug, my hard brown shell heating up with sudden rage as the cash register shorts out. Your little shop is sinking, and so are you. But right before the power cuts out completely, an anonymous transfer notification pops up on the screen. You'll see that in Level 7.

levels.name: Drax, 28, Food Influencer
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 7. Level 7: 250K views on my midnight ramen challenge and my brand deal just got canceled. My name is Drax, I am a 28-year-old dragon-fruit food influencer filming luxury recipes in a penthouse in Dallas for $35 an hour. It is 3:20 AM and I am eating plain toast with expensive truffle butter while reviewing comment sections. Without warning, a hacker shuts down my streaming channel and replaces my bio with a mocking insult. Two hundred fifty thousand views and you still fake all your recipes, dragon-fruit! I grip my camera stabilizer, my pink scale plates bristling with sudden anger as my ring light shatters on the floor. Your entire career is built on plastic food. And then my phone receives a final text message containing the coordinates of the ultimate corporate vault. You'll see that in Level 8.

levels.name: Avocado King, 40, Tycoon
levels.story: The 8 levels of midnight cooking videos. Level 8. Level 8: 999 million views on my midnight cooking empire and I still eat plain toast alone. My name is Avocado King, I am a 40-year-old avocado tycoon sitting in a glass mansion in Manhattan counting billions. It is 3:59 AM and I am looking down at the entire city where all seven fruit people are struggling in the dark. Suddenly, every single screen in the metropolis turns on simultaneously, broadcasting a live feed from the basement. You built an empire, but you forgot how it feels to share a midnight snack. I stare at his bright yellow peel and suddenly remember every single person I stepped on to get here as the massive steel vault door starts to grind open. What is your empire really worth if nobody is sitting at your table? And as the final numbers on every forehead lock into place, the screen fades to black. Das siehst du in Level 8.
